title: No success feedback after add task in No-JS mode
problem: PRG redirect shows no confirmation message. P4 said 'I think it worked but there is no confirmation'. Confidence 3/5 for T3.
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P4 L331-334; wk09/analysis/findings.md Theme 1; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 1; data/metrics.csv P4_f5a2
proposed_fix: Add flash message via query param (msg=task_added) and display success banner in template

title: Edit save confirmation not prominent enough
problem: 4/5 participants expressed uncertainty after saving. Status message too subtle. P4 confidence 2/5 for T2.
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P1-P4; wk09/analysis/findings.md Theme 2; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 2; data/metrics.csv T2_edit
proposed_fix: Enhance status message visibility with larger text or visual highlight

title: No-JS edit error message not keyboard-focusable
problem: Error appears at top of page but focus remains at form. P4 had to scroll up to find error. WCAG 3.3.1 and 2.4.3.
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P4 L311-313; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 3; data/metrics.csv P4_f5a2 T2_edit validation_error
proposed_fix: Add tabindex=-1 to error summary and focus on page load

title: Filter input not immediately discoverable
problem: P2 took 30 seconds to find filter. Suggested adding label or placeholder.
evidence: wk09/data/pilot-notes.md P2 L115-117; wk09/analysis/findings.md Theme 3; wk09/analysis/evidence-chains.md Chain 4

title: Focus management after delete could be improved
problem: After delete focus moves to next item without announcement. P3 noted slight disorientation. WCAG 2.4.3.
proposed_fix: Consider announcing deletion and new focus location via aria-live
